messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-84832 fired for sig=inference-routing-high-latency — triggered by a 5m p95 spike in router latency across us-west-2
incident-bot: Incident created and paging rotation -> alex_r
alex_r: acked — taking it
marta: handing over from alex, i'm oncall now, post anything urgent here
sre_manoj: quick glance at metrics: enqueue latency spiked ~2.5x at 10:12 UTC, small error bump but no customer 5xxs in logs
julia: logs show a short burst of retries from crawler-frontend pods (many identical requests), likely a client retry loop
alex_r: muted the synthetic check `synth-router-p95` to avoid pager flapping :mute:
marta: ran a fast probe: `curl -sS https://router-usw2.internal/health | jq .` -> status: ok
sre_manoj: router pool CPU ~78%, no OOMs, autoscaler didn't kick, KV cache hitrate dipped ~2% during spike
ops-bot: ran `redis-cli -h redis-router-1 INFO memory` — used=1.2GB, no fragmentation issues
marta: applied a 10m suppression on the alert rule to prevent noisy repeats while we triage
alex_r: keeping an eye on traces, looks like a concentrated burst from a single frontend host, maybe rollout or retry config
incident-bot: Auto-resolve window observed — waiting for sustained normal metrics
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved after ~3m, PagerDuty incident resolved
julia: confirmed no customer-facing errors; internal 429s from retry storm, cleanup happened as clients backed off
sre_manoj: likely root cause = client-side retry amplification + transient KV jitter; plan: add conservative backoff in router and follow up with frontend team to limit retries
marta: filing follow-up ticket INF-1247 and tagging frontend-team + platform for tuning
alex_r: thanks — leaving suppression for the 10m window, will monitor for 30m then close
ops-bot: suppression expired at 10m mark, alerting restored
marta: closing thread — no customer impact observed, follow-up on INF-1247 if we see recurrence :white_check_mark:
